{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Trials''' was a series of four podracing courses on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds.

#[[Mos Espa Open]] ([[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]])
#[[SoroSuub Facility]] ([[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]])
#[[Orotoru G'am (track)|Orotoru G'am]] ([[Dac/Legends|Dac]])
#[[Watchtower Run/Legends|Watchtower Run]] ([[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]])

This series was followed by the [[Podracing Open]] and the [[Hutt Championships]].

The event was partly sponsored by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], who also offered their facility on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] as a race track.

==Behind the scenes==
The Galactic Trials was the first podracing tournament faced by players in the game ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]''.
